data.name: CounterColumns
data.value: Counter columns change only by increments. Run UPDATE ... SET c = c + n in the editor.
data.comment: UPDATE ... SET c = c + n is CQL and stays as it is.

data.value: Enter a value for the primary key column {0}.

data.name: KeyspacesNeedsAccessKey
data.value: Amazon Keyspaces needs an access key ID (user name) and a secret access key (password).

data.name: KeyspacesNeedsRegion
data.value: Set the AWS region for Amazon Keyspaces in the connection's options (awsRegion).

data.name: KeyspacesNeedsTls
data.value: Amazon Keyspaces signs logins only over TLS. Set SSL to Required or stricter.

data.name: KeyspacesSignInUnavailable
data.value: Amazon Keyspaces sign-in "{0}" is not available on Windows yet. Use an access key.
data.comment: {0} is the sign-in mode entered in the options.

data.name: NoKeyspace
data.value: No keyspace named {0} was found.

data.name: NoOffset
data.value: CQL has no OFFSET, and reaching row {0:N0} would read {1:N0} rows first. Page forward from the start or filter by the partition key.
data.comment: {0} is the row number asked for, {1} the rows that would be read first.

data.name: NoTableOrView
data.value: No table or view named {0} was found.

data.name: PrimaryKeyNotLoaded
data.value: The row's value for the primary key column {0} is not loaded, so the row cannot be found.

data.name: PrimaryKeyUnreadable
data.value: The primary key of {0} could not be read, so its rows cannot be changed.

data.name: QueryCancelledServerMayFinish
data.value: Query cancelled. The server may still finish it.

data.name: RawConditionAnd
data.value: CQL joins conditions only with AND, so the raw condition must match as well as the rules.

data.name: SigV4NoNonce
data.value: Amazon Keyspaces sent a SigV4 challenge without a nonce.

data.name: SortNotApplied
data.value: Cassandra returns rows in token order and sorts only within one partition, so the sort was not applied.

data.name: StoppedAfterScanning
data.value: Stopped after reading {0:N0} rows to fill the page. Filter by the partition key to search the whole table.
data.comment: {0} is the number of rows read.

data.name: UdtAsJson
data.value: User-defined type values are written as JSON through fromJson(), not bound as objects.
